familyLabels.ring: Tower colonnade — cut away at the front, generated once

ring.line: Hand-painted 2D game art, soft painterly texture, warm sunlight from above, bright cheerful adventure-game mood, rich saturated mid-tone colour. LOW TOP-DOWN VIEW like a classic Pokemon overworld room: the camera is above and tilted forward, so you look down INTO the room and clearly see the FRONT FACES of everything standing in it. A circular open-air terrace at the top of a tall tower, alone in the middle of the image with white margin all around. THE FRONT OF THE ROOM IS CUT AWAY so you can see inside: tall columns stand only across the BACK and around the LEFT and RIGHT sides, and at the FRONT there is nothing but a LOW carved balustrade you can easily see over. The tall columns are widely spaced with big empty gaps between them and rounded arches overhead, and they repeat in a calm even rhythm. TWO MATERIALS: the columns and arches are pale warm limestone, and the balustrade and the band they stand on are much DARKER blue-grey granite, so the two read apart clearly. THE CENTRE OF THE ROOM IS COMPLETELY EMPTY - bare undecorated pale paving, no pedestal, no altar, no pattern, nothing standing there at all. Every gap between the columns, and everything beyond the terrace, is plain flat solid pure white.
